# cloudflare_workers_subdomain (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Workers Scripts Read`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_workers_subdomain" "example_workers_subdomain" {
  account_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Identifier of the Cloudflare account.

### Read-Only

- `subdomain` (String) Account-wide label used for workers.dev hostnames.
